messages:
emily: Quick sync - did a 3k-sample pass for rwd-v10-int6-hybrid. TL;DR: solid latency/cost wins but a measurable drop in multi-doc fidelity.

raj: numbers?

emily: p50 -17%, p95 -19% on canary pool. cost est -31%. Hallucination proxy: baseline fp16=2.8% -> hybrid-int6=4.6% abs +1.8% (CI +/-0.45%). agreement with baseline ranking 91.5%.

ana: hmm. that's above our soft gate. Any slice concentration?

emily: yep - concentrated on "multi-doc synthesis" and "instruction chains". single-doc extract and short QA near parity.

eval-bot: artifact uploaded -> //internal/snapshots/1799994321/hybrid-int6-diff.log. halluc_est=4.6% CI +/-0.45; baseline=2.8% CI +/-0.4. abs_delta~1.8% (LB~1.35%).

raj: LB > 1.0% so plan should avoid broad promote. propose: cancel pending 5% promote; launch 0.1% probationary canary with shadow + fp16 rerank fallback. Gate metrics: hall_abs_delta_thresh=1.0%, agreement_min=93%, p95_latency_delta_max=50ms. auto_fallback=true.

ana: add avg-logprob-delta and per-slice thresholds (user-facing multi-doc slice stricter). Also require two consecutive 24h windows with hall_abs_delta <0.7% before stepping traffic.

emily: drafting gate config (short): {mode:probationary,target_pct:0.1,duration_hours:24,metrics:[hall_abs_delta,agreement,p95_lat,avg_logprob],auto_fallback:true,fallback_policy:route-to-baseline-or-rerank}.

raj: sounds good. Also run a parallel shadow with hybrid-int6-body-fp16 to test if keeping body at fp16 mitigates the drift. If hybrid-body reduces abs delta <0.8% and agreement >94% we can consider staged bump.

emily: will run both shadows and the 0.1% canary. Cancelling 5% now and filing RL-6123 with artifacts. Quick rollback snippet for playbook: `redwood rollout cancel --id RL-6123 && redwood route set default rwd-v10-fp16`.

oncall-bot: RL-6123 created by emily. Scheduled canary start 2025-05-20T15:00Z @0.1% with shadowing and rerank hooks.

raj: add CI-based fast-fail: if CI lower bound for hall_abs_delta >1.0% at any point -> immediate rollback + page oncall. Also emit per-slice CI to the ops channel.

ana: note to attach a small human-reviewed set for multi-doc failures to the ticket. That helps triage whether it's inventing facts vs merging incorrectly.

emily: agree. I'll upload a 100-sample hand-reviewed set and kernel traces. Ping here when canary live. :rocket:
